references.text: Describes the curses that will come upon Israel if they do not obey the Lord's commands and statutes
Warning that Israel will perish if they follow other gods and forget the Lord their God
Warning against following other gods they have not known, and a reminder to follow the Lord
Warning that the heart may turn away to worship other gods, leading to destruction
Joshua's warning not to stray from the covenant and go after other gods to serve them
Warning that the Lord will turn against the people if they abandon him and serve foreign gods
The proud who wander from God's commands are cursed
The prophet Jeremiah conveys the curse upon those who do not listen to the words of the covenant
Prohibition against following other gods, for the Lord is a jealous God who will punish disobedience
The first commandment forbidding the worship of other gods, the foundation of the warning in Deuteronomy
